description: Adverse Media Screener - KYC/AML Negative News Check. Screen a person or company for adverse media (negative news) for KYC/AML and due diligence. Returns categorized, LLM-classified hits - fraud, corruption, sanctions, money laundering and more - with the entity's role, a severity score and source provenance. False positives filtered out. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

aliases.description: Alternative names / transliterations for the entity (only meaningful when screening a single entity).
aliases.title: Aliases (optional)

categories.description: If set, only return hits in these risk categories. Leave empty to return all.
categories.title: Risk categories filter (optional)

country.description: ISO country code or name to bias the search and aid disambiguation, e.g. "de", "Germany".
country.title: Country (optional)

entityNames.description: One or more person or company names to screen, e.g. ["Wirecard AG", "Jan Marsalek"]. Each entity is billed and returned as its own result.
entityNames.title: Entities to screen

entityType.description: Whether the entities are people or companies (improves disambiguation). Leave on "auto" if mixed.
entityType.title: Entity type

maxHits.description: Maximum number of adverse hits to return per entity. 1-50.
maxHits.title: Max hits per entity

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

minSeverity.description: Only return hits at or above this severity.
minSeverity.title: Minimum severity

model.description: OpenRouter model id used for classification. Default is a cheap, accurate model.
model.title: Classification model (advanced)

openRouterApiKey.description: Optional. The LLM is included; provide your own OpenRouter key only to bill classification to your own account.
openRouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter API Key (optional override)

serperApiKey.description: Optional. Search is included; provide your own Serper key only to bill search to your own account.
serperApiKey.title: Serper API Key (optional override)

name: regdata_adverse_media
